text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: Geometry and measured range-law behavior. Panel a shows 8064 non-BOS token projections in the

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: frozen (v1,v2) basis at the same layer-27 down-input site as Figure 1. Token coordinates are standardized

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: separately; unit free-direction projections are overlaid with a common multiplier of 1.0 and measured

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: in-plane lengths 0.0150 (full Hadamard) and 1.0000 (PrismQuant). Direction cosines and token standard

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: deviations are distinct quantities. Percentile-initialized bounds expand to all observed points, avoiding

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: clipping. Panel b preserves cumulative uncentered energy curves for layers 1, 13, and 27 over k=1–256 on

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: a logarithmic x axis. Panel c is supplied as three matched standalone views: 2520 E1c activation

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: observations; 280 E7 V-cache plus 112 E20 multi-slot observations; and 5342 E26 per-expert observations

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, one per routed expert, with the expert rather than the layer as the unit and f

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: measured at its own rank k<=6. All three show range relative to the paired Hadamard result against

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: sqrt(1-f), the identity line, and the same pooled linear fit over the 2912 points of the three Llama-3.2-3B

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: reference sources (R²=0.861389). The fit is not estimated separately for any view; the MoE observations

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: are held out of it entirely and their own fit (R²=0.4328) is stated in that panel. Insets enlarge the 0.85–1.0

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; fill: #1d3557

g.text: corner without omitting any point from the main panels.
